description: Exploration mission operational atmospheres with parameter-level provenance citations from flight corpus or verified user assumptions.

scenarios.title: ISS Cabin
scenarios.description: Nominal International Space Station pressurized module atmosphere at sea-level pressure.

oxygen_pct.citation_text: MCA ISS reading was used to correct the initial ISS 'air' reading of the sensor for the day via a constant offset (nominal 21.0% O2).

pressure_kpa.citation_text: Ignition tests performed subject to atmospheric pressure (101 kPa) baseline.

flow_cm_s.citation_text: Assumed nominal ISS crew cabin forced ventilation flow rate (5.0 to 20.0 cm/s specification).

gravity_g.citation_text: Microgravity forced flow flight environment aboard the ISS Microgravity Science Glovebox.

material_family.citation_text: Standard flight test reference polymer (polymethylmethacrylate slabs, rods, and films).

scenarios.title: Gateway-like Habitat
scenarios.description: Lunar Gateway orbital habitat intermediate exploration atmosphere for EVA pre-breathe mitigation.

oxygen_pct.citation_text: Low pressure with normal oxygen (21%) to isolate individual effects of pressure on piloted ignition.

pressure_kpa.citation_text: Intermediate exploration pressure baseline (10.2 psia / 70.3 kPa) used in next-generation exploration vehicle design.

flow_cm_s.citation_text: Assumed habitat interior environmental control and life support system (ECLSS) air velocity.

scenarios.title: Exploration Atmosphere (34% / 56 kPa)
scenarios.description: NASA Exploration Atmosphere (SEA) specified for Artemis / Orion / surface habitat missions to eliminate decompression sickness during frequent EVAs.

oxygen_pct.citation_text: Proposed exploration environment uses an oxygen concentration of 30 to 34% by volume chosen with material flammability in mind.

pressure_kpa.citation_text: Total cabin pressure of 52.7 to 58.6 kPa (nominal 56.0 kPa / 8.2 psia) to reduce decompression sickness risk.

flow_cm_s.citation_text: Assumed nominal ventilation duct and crew cabin forced convection velocity (10.0 cm/s).

scenarios.title: Lunar Surface Habitat
scenarios.description: Pressurized surface base on the Moon operating at Exploration Atmosphere in 1/6-g partial gravity.

oxygen_pct.citation_text: Exploration atmosphere baseline (34% O2 by volume) for EVA airlock compatibility.

pressure_kpa.citation_text: Total cabin pressure of 52.7 to 58.6 kPa (nominal 56.0 kPa / 8.2 psia).

gravity_g.citation_text: Partial gravity environment expected on future mission to the moon (0.16 g).

scenarios.title: Mars Surface Habitat
scenarios.description: Surface outpost on Mars operating at normoxic intermediate pressure in 3/8-g partial gravity.

oxygen_pct.citation_text: Assumed Mars surface habitat normoxic hypobaric mixture (28.0% O2).

pressure_kpa.citation_text: Assumed 10.2 psia (70.3 kPa) intermediate pressure habitat design.

flow_cm_s.citation_text: Assumed forced ventilation airflow velocity (10.0 cm/s).

gravity_g.citation_text: Gravity environment expected on future mission to Mars (0.38 g).

material_family.citation_text: Aramid protective flight suit and habitat textiles.
